mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS assignment_id, a.class_id, a.title, cs.student_id FROM assignment a JOIN class_student cs ON cs.class_id = a.class_id AND cs.status = 'ENROLLED' LEFT JOIN notification n ON n.user_id = cs.student_id AND n.source_type = 'ASSIGNMENT' AND n.source_id = a.id WHERE a.status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'CLOSED') AND n.id IS NULL ORDER BY a.id, cs.student_id LIMIT #{limit}
